title: 2 * DATE ( 2020, 10, 23 ) is the integer 88254

source.quote: if a multiplication operation combines an integer with a real number, DAX converts both numbers to real numbers, and the return value is also REAL
source.supports: the multiplication table above this sentence has a Date/time column: INTEGER gives INTEGER, REAL gives REAL. It has no Date/time row

source.quote: VALUE converts a text string that represents a number to a number
source.supports: the example shows DATE ( 2020, 10, 23 ) as the number 44127

derivation: The multiplication table gives INTEGER for an INTEGER multiplied by a Date/time. 2020-10-23 is day 44127. 2 * 44127 = 88254.
alternative: The table's cell is the only source and may be wrong, as a date can carry a time. If the date multiplies as a decimal number the value is the same and the type is double: 88254.0.
